prefix_note: Frames 0..input_len-1 are the TRUE trajectory, supplied to the model as context. They are not included in these arrays.
provenance: Autoregressive rollout with cached decoding. The model was trained on a single MD trajectory duplicated 1000x with rounding-suppressed noise, so the training set contained one distinct sequence.
interpretation: Per-frame correlation of 0.9327 indicates the model reproduces the training sequence rather than sampling independently from the equilibrium distribution. Agreement of the free-energy surface follows from this reconstruction and should not be read as validation of learned dynamics.
